From: Sara Patel <sara@parcelwave.com>

Cc: ParcelWave AP <ap@parcelwave.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing ask — invoice-only for 60-day pilot?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited about the latency improvements your runtime showed. We're aiming to stand up a 60-day technical pilot (small test workload) with our ML infra team next week.

One operational ask from our finance team: because ParcelWave runs a centralized vendor onboarding cadence, they can't issue a PO in time for the pilot start. Would Redwood accept an "invoice-only" temporary path for the pilot (Invoices to AP@parcelwave.com, net 30), limited to $4,500/month and with a capped total spend of $9,000 for the pilot?

I've attached our completed vendor intake form (vendor_intake_form.pdf) and can have AP route an initial remittance if that helps. If you need more details about their approval ladder I can loop in Victor (AP lead).

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can lock schedules.

Best,
Sara Patel
Head of Integrations
ParcelWave Inc.

Attachment: vendor_intake_form.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, priya.natarajan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot billing ask — invoice-only for 60-day pilot?

Team — forwarding ParcelWave request. TL;DR: 60-day tech pilot, invoice-only onboarding, cap $9k total, $4.5k/mo. External completed vendor form attached.

Proposed conditional allowance (draft):
- Temporary invoice-only exception for up to 60 days for new pilots when:
  * Requested spend <= $5,000/month AND total pilot cap <= $10,000,
  * Vendor has completed vendor intake form and provided AP contact,
  * Customer agrees to standard Redwood T&Cs via DocuSign before any billable usage,
  * Procurement issues exception memo and flags account for billing review.

If procurement signs off on the above we can proceed and set a billing guardrail on the project to prevent overruns. I'm assigning myself to coordinate DocuSign and guardrail enforcement.

Questions / objections? If procurement needs escalated approval I can ask for a one-off exception from finance.

Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot billing ask — invoice-only for 60-day pilot?

Jonas — thanks for the summary. Procurement position and required controls: we can consider a temporary invoice-only route for pilots but need the following before we approve:

1) Completed vendor intake (we have that) + active W-9 or local tax docs for vendor jurisdiction.
2) AP contact and explicit invoice-to address (email + remittance instructions).
3) Signed acknowledgement of Redwood billing terms or signed SOW/Order that includes spend cap and pilot dates. DocuSign preferred.
4) Finance wants a limit guard (billing cap) implemented on the account and an alert to the engagement owner when usage exceeds 80% of the pilot cap.

Operational notes: procurement will prepare a short exception memo (procurement_exception_memo.pdf) that documents the authority to approve this invoice-only lane. Legal should review any non-standard contract language — loop in legal if ParcelWave proposes changes.

If ParcelWave confirms the AP details and signs the DocuSign we can provision the exception within 48 business hours. Approving with condition that the cap is enforced and we have the tax docs on file.

- Laura
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
